**sdd/issue-709-declaring-selector/proposal**

**What**: Proposal for issue #709 — `brain-graph/1` becomes a TAGGED info-string selector (` ```brain-graph/1 `) in `epic-graph.mjs`, AND the shared splitter `lib/fenced-blocks.mjs` becomes delimiter/run/indentation aware (CommonMark-correct nesting). Written to `openspec/changes/issue-709-declaring-selector/proposal.md` in worktree `/home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-709` (branch `fix/issue-709-declaring-selector`, base origin/main @ b3c08a5). Artifact store: hybrid.

**Why**: `brain:epic:map` cannot distinguish a DECLARED block from a SHOWN (illustrated) one, and the splitter reads backtick fences only — so a ` ```yaml ` line nested in a `~~~console … ~~~` region (literal, non-reparsed text on GitHub) is read as a real top-level fence. Either half mints a fabricated edge. `vcs-contract.md`'s `issueRelations` row already settled the direction: a fabricated dependency is worse than an omitted one.

**Where**:
- WRITTEN: `/home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-709/openspec/changes/issue-709-declaring-selector/proposal.md`
- Root cause A: `brain/scripts/status/epic-graph.mjs:84-85` (selector = `fencedBlocks(body).blocks.filter(b => scalar(b.content,'protocol')===GRAPH_PROTOCOL)`; every token is what the header at `:11-17` teaches an author to write).
- Root cause B: `brain/scripts/lib/fenced-blocks.mjs:39` (`/^(`{3,})\s*([^`]*?)\s*$/` — backtick-only, column-0-only) and `:43` (`line.trimEnd() === open.run` — exact run, column 0).
- HARD BOUNDARY, untouched: `brain/scripts/review/lib/yaml-block.mjs:45,51` + consumers `parse-verdict.mjs:232`, `decision-block.mjs:51`, `actor-check.mjs:229-231`. Governed by design.md §E2 rule 17, signed ADR-0026, pinned REQ-487-6; sentinel `yaml-block.drift.test.mjs`.
- Regression net (must pass UNEDITED): `fenced-blocks.test.mjs`, `amendment-draft.test.mjs`, `brain-promote.amendment.test.mjs`, `brain-promote.golden.test.mjs`, `checkpoint-block.test.mjs`, `review/evaluators/checkpoint.test.mjs`, `review/cli.test.mjs`.

**Learned** (three corrections I re-measured, two of which contradict the inputs I was handed):
1. **The exploration's base-state claim is STALE.** origin/main @ b3c08a5 ALREADY has #639/PR#695 merged: `epic-graph.mjs:40` imports `fencedBlocks` and `:84-85` scans ALL fences selecting on the `protocol:` scalar with REQ-639-3's multi-block error. No `GRAPH_FENCE_TAGS` anywhere in the tree (PR #703 confirmed unmerged). Spec/design must target b3c08a5, not the exploration snapshot.
2. **The "same rendering surface" precedent is FALSE.** `brain-amendment/1` parses `*.draft.md` FILES; `brain-checkpoint/1` parses `checkpoint-report.md` (located by `review/mode.mjs:10`'s `CHECKPOINT_REPORT_RE` over changed files). Neither is a rendered issue/PR body. `issue-495/design.md:12-17` draws the family line by exactly that axis and lists `brain-graph/1` on the ` ```yaml ` side BY NAME. The codebase AGREES with #639's objection's taxonomy; it does not contradict it. The decision still stands, but on other ground: (a) the rendering cost is cosmetic — an unknown info-string still renders as a code block, only highlighting is lost; (b) migration is zero, MEASURED at `issue-639-graph-block-locator/proposal.md:53-61` — 0 of 312 issues carry a declared block, 2 mention it as prose; (c) REQ-639-3 turns residual ambiguity into a reported refusal, never a fabricated edge.
3. **The tag has a HALF-LIFE.** Once docs teach ` ```brain-graph/1 `, illustrations will reproduce the tag too — the identical mechanism that broke ` ```yaml ` + `protocol:`. The corpus tally is a habit measurement and (per #709's own comment) an inference by analogy. So the tag is a NARROWING; the load-bearing half is CommonMark-correct nesting in `fenced-blocks.mjs`.

**Decisions recorded in the proposal**:
- PR #703: SUPERSEDED — close unmerged, do NOT rebase onto it. Its whitelist `['','yaml']` keeps `yaml` admissible so the illustration path stays open; `yaml`+case-sensitivity is the source of #710's legal-shape false negatives; nothing depends on it.
- #709/#710 split: #703's two regressions are findings against an UNMERGED diff — closing #703 closes them with no code. #710's other half (CommonMark-legal shapes misread as defects) is folded into this change's axis list. CAVEAT: #710's body was unreadable in this sandbox (no shell, no `gh`) — split is conditional on that reading.
- NO dual acceptance: ` ```yaml ` + `protocol:` stops declaring. Accepting both leaves the fabrication path open.
- 14-axis test obligation: tag / delimiter / nesting both directions / closer run length / indentation 0·1-3·4+ / blockquote / list-item / HTML comment / LF-CRLF / unterminated / info-string trailing attributes / case / multiplicity incl. declared+illustrated / position.
- Rollback: TWO separate commits (selector, splitter) so each reverts independently; the unedited consumer suites are what make the splitter revert safe.

**Unverified / flagged**: no Bash, no `gh`, no network in this sandbox — issue #709 and #710 bodies and PR #703's diff were NOT read directly; all claims about them are inherited from the exploration and the launch prompt. The `0 declarations` migration claim WAS re-measured in-repo. Suspected live incident: #709/#710's own bodies illustrate the shape and may already be minting edges — verify with `brain:epic:map --dry-run` before/after.
